statements.markdown: **Theorem 6.15 (Pairwise-coprime support irrationality, Erdős 1968).** *For every integer $b\ge2$ and every infinite pairwise-coprime support $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$ with summable reciprocals, $\sum_{a\in A} 1/(b^a-1)$ is irrational.*
